title: Christian Marriage and Family
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner discusses biblical teaching on marriage and family (Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:6-9; Ephesians 5:22-6:4), explains how the church promotes values among young people before marriage (youth programmes, mentorship, counselling), and identifies values for stable families (love, faithfulness, respect, forgiveness, honesty).

floor.question: What does Genesis 2:24 say a man does when he marries?
floor.answer: Leaves his parents and is united to his wife

representations: a list of church youth activities
steps: Read Ephesians 6:1-4 on parents and children.
List how the church prepares youth.
contexts: a couple celebrating many years together

board.say: What does this teach about marriage?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say it is lasting.

misconceptions.ask: What does Genesis 2:24 say a man does?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 2:24 in full: leave father and mother, be united to his wife.

misconceptions.ask: Which value keeps a family stable?
misconceptions.repair: For each value, give a family scene that shows it.
Read Mark 10:9: what God has joined, let no one separate.

listen_for: It does nothing until the wedding
